messages:
maria: quick ask — can someone run a tinybench comparing int8 / int4 / fp8 on the "small-summarize" prompt set? I see a couple of regressions in the nightly eval and want a focused datapoint before we escalate.

bench-bot: queued run 2190011223-01 for small-summarize (variants: fp32,int8,int4,fp8). expected ~45m, priority: medium. artifacts will land in s3://redwood-quant/bench/2190011223-01/

devon: I can grab this. Do you want the default batch/seq config or the latency-shaped profile?

maria: latency-shaped please (p95 focus). Also include KV warmup = true, prefix cache on. Use 512 max tokens.

devon: got it. Running with `--profile latency --kv-warmup` and sample seed 42. Will post quick summary + diffs when done.

bench-bot: run 2190011223-01 started on pool-gpu-a (gpu:A10G x4). ETA ~47m. logs: https://ci.internal/bench/2190011223-01/logs

nate: fyi if the int4 baseline is flaky we should capture 3 repeats and compute median p95. add `--repeats 3` to the bench config.

devon: good call, adding repeats=3. also toggling contiguous-quant flag off to match production runtime (so results are comparable).

benc h-bot: update: run 2190011223-01 step=generate finished for fp32,int8,int4,fp8. postprocessing in progress. artifacts: s3://redwood-quant/bench/2190011223-01/results.json

sarah: if you see quality delta > 0.8 on rouge or >1% accuracy drop on QA, flag it for an eval sweep. we should also run the special promptset with adversarial paraphrases (small-summarize-adv) if there's noise.

devon: results uploaded. summary: fp32 p95=120ms, int8 p95=95ms (-21%), fp8 p95=88ms (-27%), int4 p95=70ms (-42%). Quality (small-summarize): delta(rouge) fp32->int8: -0.3, fp32->fp8: -0.8, fp32->int4: -2.4. Repeats consistent (median). Raw JSON: s3://redwood-quant/bench/2190011223-01/results-summary.txt

maria: thanks. int4 latency looks attractive but quality drop ~2.4 rouge is too big for this workload. fp8 is borderline (-0.8) — can you dump a small sample of examples where fp8 changed the summary? put in a gist or s3.

devon: uploading diff examples: s3://redwood-quant/bench/2190011223-01/diffs_fp8_vs_fp32.json (10 examples). Early glance: mainly hallucinated dates and split sentences.

nate: can we try fp8 with `clip_logits=true` and `scaled-embedding=false`? small config tweak might recover some of the quality without much latency hit.

devon: happy to run a quick AB with those two flags (fp8+clip vs fp8 baseline). if it's cheap i'll queue; otherwise on Monday.

maria: queue it (low priority) — label it "fp8-mitigations" and keep repeats=3. post results here. Also @sarah can you add this sample set to the regression watchlist if we see consistent fp8 deltas?

sarah: on it. I'll add the fp8 examples to the promptset and create a regression alert (threshold: rouge drop >0.5 OR QA accuracy drop >0.5%).

devon: queued ab-run 2190011223-02 (fp8+clip vs fp8) — ETA 25m. will post TL;DR when done.

bench-bot: run 2190011223-02 completed. TL;DR: clip_logits=true recovers ~0.45 rouge on median (still -0.35 vs fp32) and p95 latency +2ms vs fp8 baseline. artifacts: s3://redwood-quant/bench/2190011223-02/

maria: great — fp8+clip looks promising as a default mitigation for this family. let's capture this config in the quant recommendations doc and run a 10k sample overnight for confidence. thanks all. :rocket:
